ProjectWeave request for the selected Task (data):
{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABZdIzQg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhDEVgs", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 33, "title": "Preserve PMX SDEF through glTF conversion, VMD/VPD playback and rendering", "body": "## Problem

At `5412c0652abb8144fa1d10b45cdada8bd07a3720`, `tools/pmx-bdef.ts` rejects PMX SDEF vertices. Animated conversion therefore excludes these models. Toon uses ordinary Three.js skinning, while Outline implements its own weighted-matrix deformation. Simply admitting SDEF inputs would produce incorrect deformation or inconsistent surfaces and outlines.

The existing SDEF fixture contains only zero C/R0/R1 values and establishes rejection, not reproduction.

## Expected outcome

Add an opt-in PMX 2.0 conversion path supporting mixed BDEF/SDEF meshes, a focused runtime-independent glTF extension draft, reusable Three.js integration and an interactive Demo. SDEF must work with existing bone motion, vertex morphs and VPD offsets, including pose serialization and reload. Preserve the existing static and strict BDEF modes.

This Issue covers SDEF deformation with supported rigid joint transforms. QDEF/PMX 2.1, other morph families, IK/append ordering, physics, scene animation and representative original-MMD fidelity remain mandatory overall work. VMD animation AND VPD poses remain required.

## Context

[PMX format documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hirakuni45/glfw3_app/master/glfw3_app/docs/PMX_spec.txt) identifies SDEF's ordered bone pair, weight and C/R0/R1 values, with additional correction required. It permits BDEF2 approximation but does not equate that approximation with SDEF. This is a mirrored format-author document, not measured MikuMikuDance execution.

[Core glTF](https://registry.khronos.org/glTF/specs/2.0/glTF-2.0.html) provides joints, inverse binds, linear skinning, morph targets and animation. Reuse those representations; define only the missing SDEF information and behavior. Preserve the existing Toon/Outline drafts and their justified BDEF normal conventions.

The identified upstream [SDEF documentation](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/5ae203246ccffd86a3e8fb7be0e34b9559c33a46/docs/sdef.md) and [implementation](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/5ae203246ccffd86a3e8fb7be0e34b9559c33a46/src/skinning/MMDSdef.ts) provide a concrete center-correction/quaternion reference. They are alternative-renderer evidence. Original-MMD SDEF positions and normals remain unmeasured. Establish pinned-parser handling directly with binary fixtures; the inspected upstream parser revision is not proof of published package bytes.

Dependencies remain Three.js `0.186.1`, mmd-parser `1.1.4` and glTF Transform `4.5.1`. Official [NodeMaterial](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r186/src/materials/nodes/NodeMaterial.js) applies morphs before skinning; [Skinning.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r186/src/nodes/accessors/Skinning.js) supplies palette update and buffer/texture paths. Integration must avoid double deformation and stale palettes.

[PR #32](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/pull/32) reports 35 local tests and 12 browser tests passing after Coordinator review fixes. Inspected earlier-revision hosted logs confirm 33 tests and 12 browser passes; the merged job still reports browser checks running. Test presence, reported local execution and completed hosted execution are distinct.

No new technical correction is established. Retain the earlier correction from assumed mandatory FLOAT-weight normalization to glTF's SHOULD wording; the stricter converter policy remains justified. Further mistaken AI-authored requirements may be corrected with primary evidence, recording the old assumption, correction, source and rationale. Neither human approval nor independent AI re-review is required. Preserve the goal and relevant acceptance; unfinished implementation or failing tests cannot justify weakening them.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Define the SDEF extension, schema, complete example and semantic fixtures. Specify explicit per-vertex selection, ordered influence semantics, accessor layouts/counts, defaults, bind/model spaces, center correction, quaternion interpolation, normal handling and morph-before-SDEF order. Zero-valued centers must still select SDEF. Define interactions with Toon/Outline, supported rigid deformation, diagnostics for unsupported scale/shear and an optional, explicitly approximate BDEF2 core fallback.

- [ ] Add SDEF-capable API/CLI conversion without changing existing static/BDEF behavior. Prove that the pinned binary parser retains type and C/R0/R1, with handedness conversion and metric scaling applied exactly once. Validate indices, weights, vector layouts and finite/FLOAT ranges. Preserve core-valid joints/weights and slot-specific SDEF meaning. Produce deterministic GLB and unpacked glTF with zero core-validator errors; accurately report remaining losses and retain QDEF/PMX 2.1 rejection.

- [ ] Implement reusable loader/runtime integration independent of Toon activation. Toon, plugin-enabled PBR and Outline must use the same SDEF positions and rotation-derived normals, exactly once. Retain existing BDEF surface/Outline normal differences. Cover supported nonidentity rigid bind transforms, scene placement, palette refresh across passes, large palettes, multiple primitives, shared materials, instance isolation and disposal without global Three.js patches.

- [ ] Make CPU vertex queries and bounds agree with SDEF after pose, motion, morph and reset operations. Preserve current VMD/VPD ownership and failure atomicity. Both converter-posed outputs and runtime-applied VPD poses must retain SDEF through GLB/unpacked glTF serialization and reload; use an exporter adapter where necessary rather than copying stale accessor references. Reset/reapply must preserve original rest metadata.

- [ ] Add attributed synthetic variants of both distinct rig families with mixed BDEF/SDEF vertices, nonzero and zero C/R values, asymmetric influence pairs, endpoint weights, multiple materials and active vertex morphs. Include analytical rest, single-bone endpoint, translated-pair and twist/arc cases, quaternion-sign/near-identical cases and malformed inputs. Expected values must come from independent calculations, not production evaluators or emitted geometry. At least one arc case must clearly distinguish SDEF from BDEF2.

- [ ] Exercise both combined VMD motions and both VPD poses on both SDEF rigs through conversion and reusable playback/application. Compare CPU positions within `2e-6 m` on the bounded fixtures, retaining existing bone/morph tolerances. Read actual GPU positions and normalized normals with new-case limits of `1e-4 m` and `5e-4` component error; document fixture scale and require the distinguishing SDEF/BDEF2 difference to exceed ten times the position tolerance. Measure ordinary-loader fallback separately as approximation. Do not relax existing regression thresholds.

- [ ] Extend the built Demo with both SDEF samples, VMD transport, VPD loading/application/reset, vertex morph controls, useful diagnostics and an explicit BDEF2 comparison. Browser acceptance must observe Toon, PBR and Outline deformation, fractional seeking, repeatable reset, VPD/VMD handoff and failure recovery. Compare against independently baked geometry using existing raster limits: two encoded levels and at most 128 mismatches in 160×160 images. Preserve existing Gene, BDEF, VMD, VPD, morph, Toon and Outline coverage.

- [ ] Wire checks into existing tooling. The Coordinator records actual results for `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_CHANNEL=chromium npm run test:browser`, `npm run check:links` and `git diff --check`, using the pinned lockfile and documented setup. Update contracts, provenance and validation records with measured maxima, failures, skips and evidence limits. Implementation, testing and normal PR review remain Coordinator responsibilities; add no independent AI re-review.

## Optional validation

Capture controlled original-MMD SDEF positions, normal-sensitive renders and morph interactions using lawful synthetic inputs, or compare against an identified alternative implementation. Record versions, inputs and measured differences separately. Native WebGPU and permitted representative-model observations are useful additional evidence; they do not replace mandatory synthetic acceptance or establish overall completion.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed MMD/glTF model, VMD animation and
VPD pose reproduction goal. Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance
criteria when primary specifications or measured evidence establish the correction.
Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
